# Standcast

> Standcast orchestrates a team's daily standup. Each person drafts their daily from GitHub and Linear activity inside their AI agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, any MCP client) or the terminal, confirms it, and Standcast posts one digest per team to Slack. Open source (MIT), free during the public beta.

## Landing

- [Landing page in Markdown](https://standcast.usefachada.dev/index.md): what Standcast does, privacy, configuration, the three ways to write and the FAQ
- [Landing page in Brazilian Portuguese](https://standcast.usefachada.dev/pt-BR/index.md): the same page in pt-BR

- [Docs index in Brazilian Portuguese](https://docs-standcast.usefachada.dev/pt-BR/llms.txt): every pt-BR documentation page as Markdown
- [Full docs in Brazilian Portuguese](https://docs-standcast.usefachada.dev/pt-BR/llms-full.txt): the whole pt-BR documentation in a single file

- [Configuration](https://docs-standcast.usefachada.dev/admin/configuration): the standcast.yml reference
- [MCP server](https://docs-standcast.usefachada.dev/members/mcp): write and read dailies from any MCP client
